note: P is one design four times: same side-view red/teal bike, sunny sky, green hills, grey road, pelican pose and Pause/Speed controls, differing only in small details like a helmet or page colour. Q repeats the same scene and pelican with small additions (night mode, reverse, dark page, handlebar bell). R varies bike type (cargo bike with crate, racing bike with big wheels, plain bike with click-to-honk), road scroll and palette, so it is the most varied but still the same recipe. No design breaks the fixed pelican, bike and animated SVG.
